name: Meigui Yu Baizhanting
source:
A free historical otome game produced by a group of creators on Weibo.

July 28, 1914. Two years after her death, the will of an author was revealed at a banquet — claiming that hidden among the guests at the banquet, was a murderer.

‘One of you here is the murderer. No one is allowed to leave until this mystery is solved.’

Each hiding their own secrets, the guests began to point fingers at one another.

What they constructed together, during the Golden Age of Europe, was a crumbling Tower of Babel; and at the base of its stones, the flames of World War I begin to burn.

In the midst of finding love and understanding the pain of bloodshed, you realize that everything you’ve ever known, is a lie. Even so, will you listen? Will you learn to understand? Will you accept it all?

The person hidden within the deep dark abyss of everyone’s hearts……who is it?

[From [url=https://riebakkari.wordpress.com/2017/02/05/roses-and-byzantium-introduction/]Rie's Otoge Blog[/url]]
translation:
“微博上一群创作者制作的免费历史乙女游戏。

1914年7月28日，她去世两年后，一位作家的遗嘱在一场宴会上被揭晓——声称宴会宾客中隐藏着一名杀人犯。

‘你们这里有一个人是凶手。在这个谜团解开之前，任何人都不得离开。”

客人们各自隐藏着自己的秘密，开始互相指责。

在欧洲黄金时代，他们共同建造的是一座摇摇欲坠的巴别塔。在它的石头底部，第一次世界大战的火焰开始燃烧。

在寻找爱情和理解流血痛苦的过程中，你意识到你所知道的一切都是谎言。即便如此，你愿意听吗？你会学会理解吗？你会接受这一切吗？

隐藏在每个人内心深处的黑暗深渊中的那个人……到底是谁？

[来自[url=https://riebakkari.wordpress.com/2017/02/05/roses-and-byzantium-introduction/]Rie的Otoge博客[/url]]
